detail.longDescription:
Attached: 4 images

Brigade 0.30.0 is out. It's my open source tool for tracking and verifying work across coding agents, and as of this release the agents can message each other through one hub.

If you let agents touch real repos: each one can now get a charter saying what it owns, what it must never touch, and how work reaches it. An owners page shows each charter beside its live claims and sessions. Work no charter matches lands in Unassigned.

https://git.brigade.tools

#OpenSource #AIAgents #DevSecOps
